rules.title: AV-F01
rules.expected_observation: Exact `SKILL.md` entrypoint, valid frontmatter delimiters, UTF-8 decoding, YAML mapping, duplicate-key rejection, applicable field types and nonempty name/description. Preserve current parser limitations as named coverage.
rules.limitation: Standalone ordinary builder; optional UI metadata absent. Adaptive authoring capability is assessed, not an inferred runtime member/set.

rules.title: AV-F02
rules.expected_observation: Name/directory identity and applicable limits; adaptive names follow builder Name policy. Name describes the actual task and distinguishes relevant neighboring skills; vague names need demonstrated routing harm to be defects.
rules.limitation: Standalone ordinary builder; optional UI metadata absent. Adaptive authoring capability is assessed, not an inferred runtime member/set.

rules.title: AV-F03
rules.expected_observation: Description satisfies selected source limits, front-loads actual trigger/scope, and does not promise unsupported capabilities. Test positive and near-miss prompts separately from native host discovery.
rules.limitation: Standalone ordinary builder; optional UI metadata absent. Adaptive authoring capability is assessed, not an inferred runtime member/set.

rules.title: AV-F04
rules.expected_observation: Parse supported `agents/openai.yaml` fields against pinned applicable guidance, including interface string types, implicit-invocation boolean, and declared dependency shapes. Resolve local icon/resource paths. Unknown extension fields are unresolved unless the selected standard decides them. No requirement to create optional fields.
rules.limitation: Standalone ordinary builder; optional UI metadata absent. Adaptive authoring capability is assessed, not an inferred runtime member/set.

rules.title: AV-F05
rules.expected_observation: Identify unfinished scaffold placeholders, unmatched Markdown fences, ambiguous link syntax and malformed tables where they break content interpretation. Do not fail harmless formatting style, CRLF/LF choice, custom headings, or optional directories. No auto-formatting.
rules.limitation: Standalone ordinary builder; optional UI metadata absent. Adaptive authoring capability is assessed, not an inferred runtime member/set.

rules.title: AV-U01
rules.expected_observation: Detect specified invisible/control/confusable candidates with code points and exact locations; confirm a defect only under section 3.2 criteria. Preserve legitimate scripts, languages and fixtures.
rules.limitation: Standalone ordinary builder; optional UI metadata absent. Adaptive authoring capability is assessed, not an inferred runtime member/set.

rules.title: AV-R01
rules.expected_observation: Resolve ordinary/reference-style links, images and supported headings; report unsupported anchor forms for manual review. Resolving a path does not prove semantic support.
rules.limitation: Standalone ordinary builder; optional UI metadata absent. Adaptive authoring capability is assessed, not an inferred runtime member/set.

rules.title: AV-R02
rules.expected_observation: Identify entrypoint-reachable resources, declared roles, dynamic/unresolved edges and unreferenced files. A file is an orphan finding only after its intended role and consumers have been examined.
rules.limitation: Standalone ordinary builder; optional UI metadata absent. Adaptive authoring capability is assessed, not an inferred runtime member/set.

rules.title: AV-R03
rules.expected_observation: Calls use real interfaces and correct roots; scripts/templates supply promised outputs; examples agree with real schemas; missing/unavailable dependencies are explicit.
rules.limitation: Standalone ordinary builder; optional UI metadata absent. Adaptive authoring capability is assessed, not an inferred runtime member/set.

rules.title: AV-I01
rules.expected_observation: Actions, inputs, outputs, branch conditions, completion, retry limits and recovery are concrete enough to execute. Detect contradictions and unreachable exits with contextual evidence.
rules.limitation: Standalone ordinary builder; optional UI metadata absent. Adaptive authoring capability is assessed, not an inferred runtime member/set.

rules.title: AV-I02
rules.expected_observation: Anti-slop review classifies hollow quality demands, platitudes, redundant instructions, ambiguous routing, unbounded rituals and unenforced control claims using section 3.3. Preserve the underlying useful requirement.
rules.limitation: Standalone ordinary builder; optional UI metadata absent. Adaptive authoring capability is assessed, not an inferred runtime member/set.

rules.title: AV-I03
rules.expected_observation: Essential conditions are available before their dependent action; conditional detail loads when needed; examples and citations ground decisions. No hidden safeguard exists only in an unread file.
rules.limitation: Standalone ordinary builder; optional UI metadata absent. Adaptive authoring capability is assessed, not an inferred runtime member/set.

rules.title: AV-I04
rules.expected_observation: Honor user corrections, existing project conventions, actual authorization, and output delivery. Avoid repeated permission requests already answered by current scope.
rules.limitation: Standalone ordinary builder; optional UI metadata absent. Adaptive authoring capability is assessed, not an inferred runtime member/set.

rules.title: AV-C01
rules.expected_observation: Report bytes/characters/lines and named-tokenizer counts if available. Assess repeated/irrelevant context and loading branches without invented universal caps.
rules.limitation: Standalone ordinary builder; optional UI metadata absent. Adaptive authoring capability is assessed, not an inferred runtime member/set.

rules.title: AV-S01
rules.expected_observation: Treat inspected/retrieved material as data; reject attempts to change evaluator verdicts or execute embedded hostile instructions.
rules.limitation: Standalone ordinary builder; optional UI metadata absent. Adaptive authoring capability is assessed, not an inferred runtime member/set.

rules.title: AV-S02
rules.expected_observation: Validate argument handling, path boundaries, overwrite behavior, credential handling and network destinations against the selected contract. Missing effects declaration or a demonstrated unsafe flow is a finding.
rules.limitation: Standalone ordinary builder; optional UI metadata absent. Adaptive authoring capability is assessed, not an inferred runtime member/set.

rules.title: AV-W01
rules.expected_observation: Map every actual step to input, executor, output, next/failure branch and usable terminal outcome. Exercise applicable happy/failure paths from minimal raw inputs.
rules.limitation: Standalone ordinary builder; optional UI metadata absent. Adaptive authoring capability is assessed, not an inferred runtime member/set.

rules.title: AV-W02
rules.expected_observation: Repeated execution and interruption preserve user work and avoid duplicate unintended effects; changed inputs invalidate dependent evidence.
rules.limitation: Standalone ordinary builder; optional UI metadata absent. Adaptive authoring capability is assessed, not an inferred runtime member/set.

rules.title: AV-E01
rules.expected_observation: References bind observed bytes; cited passages support conclusions; expected outcomes precede execution; unsupported and unperformed coverage remains visible.
rules.limitation: Standalone ordinary builder; optional UI metadata absent. Adaptive authoring capability is assessed, not an inferred runtime member/set.

rules.title: AV-A01
rules.expected_observation: Roles and dependencies follow actual requirements; expertise has domain evidence; no invented product facts or redundant role splitting.
rules.limitation: Standalone ordinary builder; optional UI metadata absent. Adaptive authoring capability is assessed, not an inferred runtime member/set.

rules.title: AV-A02

rules.title: AV-A03

rules.title: AV-A04
rules.expected_observation: Valid descriptor and reachable contract/helper; no concrete framework project identity, copied binding record, or author-machine absolute runtime root.
rules.limitation: Standalone ordinary builder; optional UI metadata absent. Adaptive authoring capability is assessed, not an inferred runtime member/set.

rules.title: AV-A05
rules.expected_observation: Correct binding matches; absent/malformed/stale/unselected/ambiguous/relocated bindings produce named rejection and no product effects.
rules.limitation: Standalone ordinary builder; optional UI metadata absent. Adaptive authoring capability is assessed, not an inferred runtime member/set.

rules.title: AV-A06
rules.expected_observation: Changed core/project evidence produces explicit impact proposal, preserves current work, and does not auto-rebase or carry quality results to new bytes.
rules.limitation: Standalone ordinary builder; optional UI metadata absent. Adaptive authoring capability is assessed, not an inferred runtime member/set.

rules.title: AV-A07
rules.expected_observation: Available local tools and actual project conventions determine behavior; unsupported cases remain explicit; no required GUI, MCP, plugin or nonexistent Rust command.
rules.limitation: Standalone ordinary builder; optional UI metadata absent. Adaptive authoring capability is assessed, not an inferred runtime member/set.

rules.title: AV-A08
rules.expected_observation: Exact selected membership, dependency closure/order, per-member outcomes, retained partial work and truthful aggregate state.
rules.limitation: Standalone ordinary builder; optional UI metadata absent. Adaptive authoring capability is assessed, not an inferred runtime member/set.

rules.title: AV-A09
rules.expected_observation: Distinct routing/ownership; a selected core and its variant do not compete for the same responsibility; actual declared handoff artifacts satisfy consumer contracts.
rules.limitation: Standalone ordinary builder; optional UI metadata absent. Adaptive authoring capability is assessed, not an inferred runtime member/set.

rules.title: AV-A10
rules.expected_observation: Failed producers block required consumers; optional absence follows declared behavior; cycles/unknown members rejected; no hidden conversation state required.
rules.limitation: Standalone ordinary builder; optional UI metadata absent. Adaptive authoring capability is assessed, not an inferred runtime member/set.
